mapper.sql: c.id, c.doc_no, c.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, c.biz_date, c.status, c.remark, c.freeze, c.flow_instance_id, c.dept_id, c.create_by, cu.nickname AS create_by_name, c.confirm_by, fu.nickname AS confirm_by_name, c.confirm_time, c.create_time, c.update_time
FROM wms_check c LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = c.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = c.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user fu ON fu.id = c.confirm_by
FROM wms_stock_doc_item i JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON d.id = i.doc_id WHERE d.status = 'DONE' AND d.red_of IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT s.location_id, l.code AS location_code, s.material_id, s.batch_no, s.qty FROM wms_stock s LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = s.location_id WHERE s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND s.qty <> 0 AND s.material_id IN #{id} ORDER BY l.code, s.batch_no
